confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Livingstone food and drink prices. The food and drink results were sparse and crowdsourced, and the sites disagreed. Restaurant meals, beer and coffee are anchored on those figures, adjusted upward for Livingstone's tourist-oriented venues. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local relationship to beer, not found directly. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any booking pages or listings. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 4 pm figure of 0.6720 USD per AUD. A provisional 19 November figure of 0.6677 appeared in the search results, but I could not match it to an official confirmed entry, so I used the confirmed one.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Livingstone-specific crowdsourced indexes, Lusaka and national Zambia figures, and the tourist premium typical of Victoria Falls-area destinations.
